herc_rentals.domain: Equipment Rental, Fleet Operations & Billing Analytics
herc_rentals.business_context: Legacy processes relied on full-refresh load patterns and monolithic transformation chains that caused severe compute overhead, long daily batch runtimes, and costly rerun efforts upon failure.

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Extracting high-volume operational records from legacy/on-prem sources and streaming real-time IoT equipment telemetry payloads.
swappable_categories: Ingestion Tools (Kafka, Fivetran, Event Hubs, Debezium)

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Landing high-throughput raw operational and telemetry datasets into structured cloud storage layers.
swappable_categories: Cloud Storage (Azure ADLS, Google Cloud Storage, MinIO)

phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Building PySpark and Spark SQL pipelines to clean, normalize, and process CDC incremental updates while decoupling monolithic transformation chains into modular, restartable stages.
key_optimizations: Replaced full-refresh cycles with scheduled incremental load patterns
Tuned partition strategies and optimized Spark SQL joins
Decoupled pipelines into modular checkpointed stages
swappable_categories: Transformation & Modeling (dbt, Apache Flink, Snowflake SQL, BigQuery)

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Managing pipeline dependencies with retry policies, enforcing schema validation, and structuring dimensional star schemas and materialized tables in Teradata.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.phase_name: Semantic Layers & BI Serving (SUPPRESS IF ROLE IS PURE BACKEND DE)
phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Building optimized SQL semantic reporting layers and interactive dashboards to deliver operational and fleet metrics to business leadership.

metrics_and_impact.rerun_reduction: Decreased pipeline rerun effort by 30–40% through modular stage design
metrics_and_impact.runtime_reduction: Reduced daily batch runtimes by 25–30% via PySpark partition tuning and Spark SQL join optimization
metrics_and_impact.reliability: Ensured 0% data loss across multi-terabyte datasets spanning rental, inventory, and billing operations

blue_yonder.business_context: Ingestion and transformation of massive, multi-tenant retail supply chain datasets suffered from Spark Catalyst planning bottlenecks on wide transformations and unoptimized queries in downstream analytical models.

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Constructing programmatic REST API services to securely ingest, validate, and parse complex client ERP JSON payloads and flat files.

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Routing standardized ERP payloads into cloud lake storage while automating cloud infrastructure provisioning with strict security controls.
native_tools: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2)
swappable_categories: IaC & Cloud Storage (AWS S3, CloudFormation, GCP Cloud Storage)

phase_3_transformation.phase_name: Distributed Data Processing & Catalyst Plan Optimization
phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Engineering distributed pipelines to cleanse, deduplicate, and merge retail datasets, eliminating Spark Catalyst planning overhead by consolidating iterative column operations into unified single-pass DataFrames.
key_optimizations: Eliminated Spark Catalyst planning overhead by consolidating iterative casting/enrichment into single-pass operations
Eliminated unnecessary repartitioning and tuned partition boundaries
swappable_categories: Distributed Compute (Apache Spark, dbt, EMR, Dataproc)

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Orchestrating multi-tiered batch DAGs, tracking job health via cloud monitoring, and tuning downstream data warehouse models through query profiling and partition pruning.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.phase_name: Self-Service Analytics Views (SUPPRESS IF ROLE IS PURE BACKEND DE)
phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Designing enterprise analytical models and views connecting Snowflake to business intelligence tools for stakeholder consumption.

tech_stack: Azure (ADLS Gen2, Databricks, Key Vault, Monitor, RBAC)

metrics_and_impact.runtime_reduction: Reduced batch transformation runtimes by 25–30% through PySpark Catalyst optimization and partition tuning
metrics_and_impact.cost_and_efficiency: Significantly cut compute expenditure and eliminated latency bottlenecks in Snowflake and Exasol

accenture.business_context: Legacy modernization migrating on-premises Mainframe and Ab Initio workflows to AWS. Heavy pipeline degradation caused by full-table merge patterns and severe data skew across multi-billion-row financial transaction tables.

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Decoupling legacy Ab Initio ETL graphs by authoring custom Python ingestion services that stream on-premise transactional and compliance data to the cloud.

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Structuring multi-tiered Bronze, Silver, and Gold storage layers and registering metadata for seamless enterprise discovery.
swappable_categories: Metadata & Catalogs (Unity Catalog, Apache Atlas, Alation, Google Dataplex)

phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Diagnosing cluster bottlenecks using Spark UI, mitigating data skew on multi-billion-row tables using data salting, AQE, and Broadcast Hash Joins, and replacing full merges with partition-aware anti-joins.
key_optimizations: Resolved data skew via data salting and Broadcast Hash Joins
Enabled Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) and Dynamic Partition Pruning (DPP)
Replaced full-table merges with partition-aware anti-join and append patterns

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Modeling dimensional schemas and materialized views for financial crime analytics, orchestrating Airflow DAGs, and maintaining automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.phase_name: Regulatory & Commercial BI Reporting (SUPPRESS IF ROLE IS PURE BACKEND DE)
phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Building compliance dashboards and analytical models for commercial stakeholders and regulatory audits.

metrics_and_impact.runtime_reduction: Reduced financial pipeline execution runtimes by 35–40% by eliminating distributed data skew and tuning query plans
metrics_and_impact.audit_accuracy: Achieved 100% data reliability for regulatory compliance through automated reconciliation and variance checks

thomson_reuters.business_context: Sales and customer usage data was trapped in on-premise relational databases. Early AWS migrations hit severe write bottlenecks due to Parquet file write distribution and S3 metadata rename penalties.

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Extracting historical relational records and sales data from enterprise databases into the cloud ecosystem.
swappable_categories: Extraction Tools (AWS DMS, Stitch, Fivetran, Kafka Connect)

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Landing extraction files into S3 and executing native transformations on unstructured/flat files.

phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Authoring PySpark and Glue jobs to clean and aggregate revenue metrics, resolving batch write delays by tuning Parquet block/page sizes and S3 partition keys.
key_optimizations: Tuned Parquet block/page sizes and Snappy compression
Eliminated S3 metadata rename overhead through optimized partitioning
swappable_categories: Serverless ETL (Databricks Serverless, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Dataflow)

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.phase_name: Analytical Querying, Data Quality & Storage Management
phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Loading curated sales datasets into analytical stores, writing complex SQL window functions, and enforcing daily data validation checkpoints.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.phase_name: Executive Sales & Revenue BI (SUPPRESS IF ROLE IS PURE BACKEND DE)
phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Designing and deploying interactive Tableau, Power BI, and SSRS dashboards connected directly to Athena and Redshift for revenue KPIs.

metrics_and_impact.latency_reduction: Cut batch write latency and storage delays by 20–25% via Parquet block sizing and S3 partition tuning
metrics_and_impact.reporting_performance: Improved database reporting execution times by 40% through index optimization, partitioning, and query tuning
